description: acp — Agent Communication Protocol CLI. 35+ coding agents (Claude, Gemini, Cursor, Copilot, Cline, Goose, Codex, Kilo, Junie, Qwen, Mistral, Kimi, OpenCode, etc.). ACP standardizes communication between editors and AI coding agents. 3k+ stars.

agents.note: Status: ok=works out of box, auth=needs API key, timeout=first-run delay possible, skip=not installable automatically

working_out_of_box.description: These ACP servers work with initialize + session/new + prompt without any API keys. Use these first.

works_with_free_model.description: Handshake OK, prompt needs model override via --model flag or OpenRouter config. Add openrouter provider to enable free model routing.

handshake_ok_auth_gated.description: Initialize + session/new work, but prompts need API keys. Override model via --model flag if the agent supports custom providers.

agents.claude-acp: can use OpenRouter free model via --model flag

first_run_slow.description: npx agents that take >15s on first run due to package download. Be patient or pre-install.

binary_not_auto_installable.description: Require manual download from GitHub releases. Cannot auto-install via acp-cli.

steps: 3. Use with acp-cli: --model xiaomi/mimo-v2-flash or --model openrouter/free
4. Free models that work: xiaomi/mimo-v2-flash, openrouter/free, google/gemini-2.0-flash-exp

model_override_notes.protocol: ACP session/set_config_option with params: { sessionId, configId: 'model', value: 'provider/model-name', type: true }
